s-1.ptxt: Remove Transfer & Transaxle Setting Stud Bolt

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 stud bolts.
Install the transfer assembly to the overhaul attachment.
Remove the 2 transfer case straight pins.
Remove transfer case plug No.1 and the gasket.
Using socket hexagon wrench 10, remove the transfer drain plug and gasket.
Using socket hexagon wrench 10, remove transfer case plug No.2 (filler plug) and the gasket.
Using SST, remove the transfer case oil seal from the transfer case.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to damage the oil seal press-fit surface.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Transfer Case Oil Seal RH

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the transfer case oil seal RH from the transfer case.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to damage the oil seal press-fit surface.

s2.ptxt: Install the nut to the stud bolt.

atten4.ptxt: The propeller shaft installation nut can be used as the nut.

s2.ptxt: Using a torque wrench, inspect the turning torque (total preload) with the driven pinion and ring gear tooth surfaces in contact.

specitem.ptxt: Total preload = Driven pinion preload + 0.28 to 0.79N*m{2.9 to 8.1kgf*cm}

item.ptxt: Install the torque wrench as shown in the illustration.
Inspect the turning torque at approximately 60 r/min (1 revolution/1 seconds).

s2.ptxt: Insert a dial indicator through the transfer case plug No.2 hole and place it perpendicular to the tip of the ring gear tooth surface.
While holding the transfer output shaft by hand, turn the transfer ring gear mounting case back and forth by hand to measure the backlash between the ring gear and driven pinion.

atten3.ptxt: Inspect at 3 or more locations around the circumference of the ring gear.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 bolts.
Using a brass bar and hammer, remove transfer case cover No.1 from the transfer case.

item.ptxt: Place the brass bar against the rib of transfer case cover No.1.
Do not damage the mating surface of the transfer case.

s2.ptxt: Remove the transfer ring gear from the transfer case.
Remove the 2 transfer case straight pins from the transfer case.
Install the nut to the stud bolt.

atten4.ptxt: The propeller shaft installation nut can be used as the nut.

s2.ptxt: Using a torque wrench, inspect the turning torque of the driven pinion (driven pinion preload).

item.ptxt: Install the torque wrench as shown in the illustration.
Inspect the turning torque at approximately 60 r/min (1 revolution/1 seconds).

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 bolts and remove the transfer output shaft assembly from the transfer case.
Secure the transfer output shaft assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using SST and a hammer, unstake the nut.

item.ptxt: When using the SST, use it with the flat surface facing outward.
Never grind the tip of SST with a grinder or similar tool.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), remove the nut.
Using SST and a press, remove the transfer driven pinion from the transfer output shaft.

atten3.ptxt: Support so that no load is applied to the bearing outer race as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Transfer Output Rear Shaft Dust Deflector

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the dust deflector from the shaft.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Transfer Driven Pinion Bearing Front

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the transfer driven pinion bearing FR from the transfer driven pinion.

atten3.ptxt: Support so that no load is applied to the bearing outer race as shown in the illustration.

s2.ptxt: Remove the O-ring from the transfer driven pinion bearing FR.
Remove the transfer output shaft washer from the transfer driven pinion.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Ring Gear Mounting Case Bearing

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the ring gear mounting case bearing (inner race) from the mounting case.

item.ptxt: Apply grease to the threads and tip of SST (09953-04030) before use.
Do not deform the cage of the mounting case bearing. (When reusing the bearing)
Put left/right (back side, tooth side) identification marks on the mounting case bearings and keep them separate.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, remove the ring gear mounting case bearing (outer race) from transfer case cover No.1.
Remove the ring gear mounting case washer from transfer case cover No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Ring Gear Mounting Case Bearing

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the ring gear mounting case bearing (inner race) from the mounting case.

item.ptxt: Apply grease to the threads and tip of SST (09950-00030) before use.
Do not deform the cage of the mounting case bearing. (When reusing the bearing)
Put left/right (back side, tooth side) identification marks on the mounting case bearings and keep them separate.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, remove the ring gear mounting case bearing (outer race) from the transfer case.
Remove transfer ring gear mounting case washer No.2 from the transfer case.
Using SST, remove the shaft snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Transfer Ring Gear Mounting Case

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the transfer ring gear from the transfer ring gear mounting case.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the breather oil deflector from the transfer case.
Using a chisel and hammer, lift the transfer case breather plug slightly.
Lightly pry with a flat-tip screwdriver to remove the transfer case breather plug from the transfer case.
